notes.title: FULL VERSION | Get Ready for the Playtest! 🤩
notes.notes:
👨‍🍳 Playtest will start this week! 👩‍🍳


 🗓️ Mark your calendar 🗓️
November 24, 2023, at 12:00 PM CET! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/


Join our culinary adventure, discover a symphony of flavors and sensations in the upcoming Playtest of the demo version!

Be one of the first players to receive access to the demo version - Playtess will be time-limited and access will also be limited, so sign up now to don't miss your chance!

Sstep-by-step recipe how to sign up for the upcoming Playtest:
1. Login to your Steam account
2. Go to the ASMR Food Experience Steam page
3. Scroll a little lower on the page
4. You will see the banner like below 👇 and click the green button "request access"
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/78bf99322d9d14e1ec8b9a73864114b3a5ee883e.gif


In the meantime check out the newest gameplay trailer! 🔥

[previewyoutube=fLCxCbQXQbk;full][/previewyoutube]

Also join us on Discord, where you can chat directly with the team and other members of our amazing community 😎
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/4dadcda3a20b495658e1be8fa728a0d6b36dd7b7.png

See you soon
ASMR Food Experience Team

notes.title: FULL VERSION | SIGN UP FOR PLAYTEST! 📝
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Players! 👋

Right now you have the opportunity to sign up for Playtest of the demo version! 😍

All you have to do is go to the Steam main page of ASMR Food Experience  
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066740/ASMR_Food_Experience/

Then found the green banner you see below. 👇 Click on the "request access" button and that's it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/78bf99322d9d14e1ec8b9a73864114b3a5ee883e.gif

You don't need to do anything else - now just wait for the email with the invite. 📫

This is the first very important event in the production of our game, so we hope that you will be happy to join and be a part of the upcoming Playtests!

You can join us on Discord to chat directly with us and the rest of our amazing community! 😊
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655126/4dadcda3a20b495658e1be8fa728a0d6b36dd7b7.png 

See you soon!
ASMR Team
